snippet.title: Abyssus - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Hey everyone! I've been working on a game for University called "Abyssus". It's a Top Down Roguelike where you need to find the grail at the end of a randomly generated dungeon. Here is the trailer we made for it, along with some new music.

You can download and play Abyssus for free from over here: http://pgt13-5a.blogspot.nl/p/download.html

You can download the soundtrack here: 
http://music.emilevankrieken.com/album/abyssus

We hope you like it!

Website: http://EmilevanKrieken.com
Facebook: https://facebook.com/EmilevanKriekenMusic
Twitter: https://twitter.com/EmilevanKrieken 

You can use my music in your (monetized) Youtube video's, if you want! I'll be super happy when you mention my name in the description when you do :) For full details about this, check out http://emilevankrieken.com/copyright-policy/
